title: Yamunotri Dham Hit by Avalanche: Routes Damaged, Heavy Snow Blocks Access Ahead of Char Dham Yatra
text:
Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand — March 26, 2026
The sacred Himalayan pilgrimage site Yamunotri Dham has suffered extensive damage following a recent avalanche, raising serious concerns ahead of the upcoming Char Dham Yatra.
Officials and temple authorities reported that multiple sections of the trekking route leading to the shrine have been damaged, while several feet of snow have accumulated across key areas, disrupting accessibility.
Avalanche Causes Widespread Damage
According to on-ground assessments, an avalanche struck areas near the temple, severely damaging horse shelters (Ghoda Padaav) and nearby tin structures. The main pedestrian route connecting the shrine has also been impacted.
The situation is equally severe in Bhairav Valley, where avalanche activity has left trekking paths buried under snow and debris. Large trees uprooted by the impact are further obstructing movement.
Routes Blocked, Workers Stranded
Temple committee officials, including treasurer Pradeep Uniyal and co-secretary Gaurav Uniyal, conducted a ground inspection and highlighted the urgency of restoration work.
They stated that:
- Several feet of snow remain accumulated across the route
- Trekking paths are completely damaged in multiple stretches
- Workers assigned for safety and repair work are currently stranded at Jankichatti, unable to proceed due to blocked routes
- Essential materials are also failing to reach the shrine
Concerns Ahead of Char Dham Yatra
With only a few days left before the start of the annual pilgrimage, authorities have yet to initiate full-scale restoration work, raising concerns among local stakeholders.
Temple officials warned that delayed or incomplete repairs could lead to serious inconvenience for pilgrims, especially if emergency restoration is rushed just before the yatra begins.
Official Response
Public Works Department Executive Engineer Tarun Kamboj stated that initial reports suggested snow clearance work had been completed on parts of the route. However, a ground inspection has been scheduled to assess the actual situation.
Situation Summary
An avalanche at Yamunotri Dham has damaged trekking routes, buried paths under heavy snow, and stranded workers, raising concerns ahead of the Char Dham Yatra.
FAQ Section (Google Rich Results Optimized)
Q1. What caused the damage at Yamunotri Dham?
Recent heavy snowfall triggered an avalanche, damaging routes and structures near the shrine.
Q2. Are routes to Yamunotri Dham currently open?
No, several trekking paths are damaged and blocked by snow and debris.
Q3. Are workers stranded in the area?
Yes, workers heading for repair work are currently stranded at Jankichatti due to blocked routes.
Q4. Will this affect the Char Dham Yatra?
Delays in restoration may impact pilgrims if repairs are not completed in time.
